candidates.source_name: Vestník verejného obstarávania (ÚVO) — official bulletin, notices index
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication channel under zákon 343/2015 Z.z.: every Slovak contract notice, award notice (oznámenie o výsledku VO), contract modification, cancellation and summary report must appear here. Highest-yield primary channel for banking/payments contracts (CPV 66xxx, 30144000/30233300, 72xxx).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the machine-readable daily XML mirror on data.slovensko.sk; use HTML issue pages only as fallback/verification. Poll per issue number (Vestník N/YYYY).
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ÚVO site structure
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankové služby CPV 66100000
uvo.gov.sk vestník oznámenie o výsledku verejného obstarávania platobné služby banka

candidates.source_name: ÚVO — Vyhľadávanie zákaziek (contract search with CPV filters)
candidates.why_relevant: The query interface over the bulletin corpus; supports CPV, authority, procedure-type and date filters — the operational entry point for building a CPV 66100000 / 66110000 / 66172000 / 30144000 / 30233300 / 72xxx watchlist.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parameterised search per CPV code, paginated scrape at low rate; snapshot result lists and follow to notice detail pages.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankové služby CPV 66100000

candidates.source_name: Národný katalóg otvorených dát — Vestník VO daily XML datasets (ÚVO/NASES)
candidates.why_relevant: Each Vestník issue is published as an open-data XML dataset (e.g. 'Vestník 79/2026', 'Vestník 217/2025'), enabling deterministic, machine-readable ingestion of every notice including CPV codes, authority IDs, winners and awarded values — the ideal backbone for an automated A2 pipeline.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate ÚVO's publisher page in the catalogue via its DCAT/CKAN API, download per-issue XML distributions, filter on CPV prefixes 661/6617/3014/3023/72.
queries_used: data.slovensko.sk dataset "vestník verejného obstarávania" XML úrad pre verejné obstarávanie otvorené dáta

candidates.source_name: IS EVO / Elektronická platforma VO — EVO portal contract search
candidates.why_relevant: The mandatory electronic platform (povinné používanie od 1.2.2023) where the actual procurement procedure runs: tender documentation (súťažné podklady), Q&A, bid opening records. Gives technical requirement detail on POS terminals, ATMs, card issuing and processing far beyond the bulletin summary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Public OrderSearch scrape by keyword/CPV; follow DocumentSearch/GetAttachment links to pull súťažné podklady PDFs for spec extraction. Registration only needed to bid, not to read.
queries_used: IS EVO evo.isepvo.sk elektronická platforma zákazka platobný terminál bankomat

candidates.source_name: isepvo.sk — Elektronická platforma documentation & user manuals
candidates.why_relevant: Documents how IS EVO structures notices, document types and identifiers; the user manuals (manual_uchadzac.pdf, verejna_sutaz_vo.pdf) are effectively the schema reference for building a reliable collector against the platform.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch of manual PDFs; re-check on platform version changes.
queries_used: IS EVO evo.isepvo.sk elektronická platforma zákazka platobný terminál bankomat

candidates.source_name: ÚVO — Elektronické verejné obstarávanie (EVO) hub page
candidates.why_relevant: ÚVO's own map of which system carries which contract type (EVO vs EKS vs private certified systems). Essential to avoid systematically missing below-threshold banking/payments purchases that never hit the Vestník.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic re-read (quarterly) to detect platform/legal changes.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankové služby CPV 66100000

candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative SK-language CPV code list; needed to fix the exact code set and Slovak labels used for banking, payment-processing, card and terminal categories in query construction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off download of the CPV file; store as local lookup table.
queries_used: ÚVO vestník verejného obstarávania bankové služby CPV 66100000

candidates.source_name: UVOstat.sk — restructured ÚVO procurement data (results, CPV browse, buyer-supplier links)
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party rebuild of the ÚVO corpus with far better navigation: browse by CPV code, per-supplier and per-authority histories, links to CRZ contracts. Fastest way to reconstruct historical award share for banks/payment vendors in SK public sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a discovery/backfill layer (CPV listing pages), then re-verify every fact against the ÚVO primary notice before reporting.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search + snowball via open-data catalogue application entry
queries_used: uvostat.sk CPV 66172000 spracovanie platobných transakcií zákazky Slovensko
slovensko.digital ekosystem otvorené dáta verejné obstarávanie monitoring vestník uvostat tender

candidates.why_relevant: Contracts of state bodies and public institutions must be published here (§5a zák. 211/2000) and are only effective once published — so the signed banking/card/acquiring contract text, pricing annexes and terms appear here even when the procurement itself was below-threshold. Confirmed hits like 'Zmluva o vydaní a používaní platobnej karty' with Prima banka.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword search on Slovak banking/payments terms (platobná karta, akceptácia platobných kariet, POS terminál, bankomat, vedenie účtu, úver) plus counterparty = bank IČO; download contract PDFs. Mirror available via Slovensko.Digital API.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles (who must publish the resulting contract) + search
queries_used: Centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva banka platobné karty ministerstvo
local_language_terms_used: zmluva o vydaní a používaní platobnej karty

candidates.source_name: Ekosystém.Slovensko.Digital — open data & API (CRZ, obchodný vestník, ÚVO-derived)
candidates.why_relevant: Provides REST/SQL APIs and SQL dumps over the central contract register and related registers since 2011, with ÚVO named among cited sources — the cheapest way to run bulk historical queries instead of scraping CRZ HTML.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read /podmienky first (attribution obligations), then use REST/SQL API or dump for full-text search across contract subjects.
queries_used: slovensko.digital ekosystem otvorené dáta verejné obstarávanie monitoring vestník uvostat tender

candidates.source_name: Elektronický kontraktačný systém (EKS) / elektronické trhovisko — portal.eks.sk
candidates.why_relevant: Below-threshold and low-value contracts (zákazky s nízkou hodnotou) for commonly available goods/services are contracted here, typically via 72-hour auctions — captures small POS/terminal/card and banking-service purchases that never reach the Vestník. ~100k trades, >EUR 1bn cumulative.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate 'Detail zákazky' pages (stable numeric IDs, e.g. /SpravaZakaziek/Zakazky/Detail/354088) or use the portal's search; filter by Slovak keyword set. Note: the search URL above is inferred from observed detail-page structure and is unverified.
queries_used: Elektronický kontraktačný systém eks.sk trhovisko zákazka nízkej hodnoty banková služba

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (SK above-threshold notices) + TED API
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak above-threshold notices are mirrored to TED in structured eForms with stable CPV metadata and full multilingual fields; the documented TED API and bulk XML packages make it the most robust programmatic complement to the national Vestník for large banking/payments contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED search API with expert query filtering country=SVK and CPV in {66100000,66110000,66172000,30144000,30233300,72*}; schedule daily.
queries_used: Slovakia public procurement open data API TED notices uvo.gov.sk otvorené dáta vestník export

candidates.source_name: OpenTender / Open Contracting Data Registry — Slovakia publication
candidates.why_relevant: Government Transparency Institute normalises SK national-portal plus TED data into OCDS across 35 jurisdictions, enabling cross-country benchmarking of banking/payments procurement volumes and supplier concentration — analytic layer, not a primary record.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Bulk OCDS download; treat coverage/lag as approximate and re-verify against ÚVO.
queries_used: Slovakia public procurement open data API TED notices uvo.gov.sk otvorené dáta vestník export

candidates.why_relevant: Commercial monitor with per-tender pages and CPV browsing; observed a concrete banking-sector item (SWIFT Credit Bureau services for EXIMBANKA SR), confirming it surfaces niche financial-services contracts. Useful as an alerting layer and cross-check on ÚVO indexing lag.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume monitoring of public tender pages and the CPV index; do not bulk-scrape — check ToS. Use only for lead discovery, verify in ÚVO.

candidates.why_relevant: Bidder-side service summarising and alerting on Vestník notices; secondary value as an alerting redundancy and as a plain-language guide to notice types (oznámenie o vyhlásení VO vs o výsledku VO) used in parsing rules.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Occasional manual read; no automated collection.

candidates.source_name: ÚVO — Register verejných obstarávateľov / registre o hospodárskych subjektoch
candidates.why_relevant: Canonical identifiers for contracting authorities (and the economic-operator registers) — the join key that lets notices, CRZ contracts and company data be linked into one supplier/authority graph for banking and payments.

candidates.why_relevant: Authorities record delivered-contract references for suppliers; reveals which vendors have actually executed banking/payments contracts and how the buyer rated them — a rare quality signal on incumbents that award notices do not carry.

candidates.source_name: Contracting-authority procurement profiles (e.g. MO SR, MH SR, MPSVR SR, indprop.gov.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Each authority runs a 'profil verejného obstarávateľa' publishing its own contracts, orders and invoices — often earlier and with more annexes than the central bulletin, and covering low-value banking/payments purchases. Useful for targeted monitoring of the big spending ministries and state-owned entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Maintain a shortlist of ~20 high-relevance authorities (ministries, Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa, Slovenská pošta, ŽSR, state banks) and poll their profile pages plus zmluvy/objednávky/faktúry sections.

negative_findings.description: Could not surface, via search alone, a single concrete ÚVO Vestník notice page carrying CPV 66100000 / 66172000 for a Slovak banking or payment-processing contract.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines return ÚVO section pages and CPV code lists rather than individual notice detail URLs; ÚVO notice pages appear poorly indexed. The one concrete financial-services tender observed (SWIFT Credit Bureau services, EXIMBANKA SR) surfaced only via the commercial aggregator verejnesutaze.sk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword web search is not a viable discovery route for this cell — collection must go through the ÚVO/EVO on-site CPV search, the daily Vestník XML open data, or TED, not through a search engine.

negative_findings.description: The ÚVO root domain https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ appeared in results with the title 'Error'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Not fetched directly in this pass, so no verdict. Most likely a transient error page, a bot-defence response, or an indexing artefact; deep pages (vestnik-a-registre, vyhladavanie) index normally.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The verification pass should treat a bad response on uvo.gov.sk as unverified rather than dead, and should retry with a browser-like user agent before flagging the backbone source.

negative_findings.description: No confirmed public search/listing endpoint for EKS (elektronické trhovisko) contract browsing was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only individual 'Detail zákazky' URLs (portal.eks.sk/SpravaZakaziek/Zakazky/Detail/<id>) and marketing pages were observed; the listing URL recorded for that candidate is inferred and explicitly flagged as unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Below-threshold banking/payments purchases could be systematically missed until the EKS listing/search entry point is established.

negative_findings.description: Slovak procurement search terms for ATM/POS hardware ('bankomat', 'platobný terminál') returned no procurement-platform hits in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Queries combining IS EVO/EKS with 'platobný terminál' and 'bankomat' returned only platform documentation, with search-engine commentary explicitly noting those terms were absent from the indexed content.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hardware-side CPV codes (30144000, 30233300) may need on-portal CPV filtering plus a broader Slovak lexicon (samoobslužné zariadenie, snímač kariet, akceptácia platobných kariet, obsluha bankomatov, cash handling) rather than the obvious two terms.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact CPV filter syntax and URL parameters of the ÚVO 'Vyhľadávanie zákaziek' interface and the EVO OrderSearch were not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Drive both search UIs in a browser session, capture the resulting query URLs/POST bodies, and codify them as reusable collector endpoints.

coverage_gaps.description: No contracting-authority shortlist yet for banking/payments demand (which SK public bodies actually buy acquiring, card issuing, cash logistics, ATM services, core-banking IT).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an actor map from CRZ/UVOstat supplier-side queries on the major SK banks and payment vendors (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, Poštová banka, Prima banka, 365.bank, Global Payments, Worldline, Nexi, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR/Atleos, Loomis, Brink's, Printec) and invert to their public-sector counterparties.

coverage_gaps.description: ÚVO review/appeal decisions (rozhodnutia, námietky, revízne postupy) were not located as a distinct browsable source in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate the ÚVO decisions register / rozhodnutia section and assess it as a source — challenged banking/payments tenders yield unusually rich detail on requirements, pricing and competitor positioning.

coverage_gaps.description: Cell was scoped to the public/statutory channel; utilities-sector obstarávatelia and state-owned enterprises procuring payment acceptance (transport operators, Slovenská pošta, energy utilities) were not specifically probed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass on obstarávateľ (utilities) notices and SOE buyer profiles for ticketing/payment-acceptance contracts.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of this cell is thin and mostly low-quality commercial tender-lead sites.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on TED's English-language rendering of SK notices for EN-language reporting rather than commercial aggregators; avoid globaltenders/tendersinfo-class sites as sources.

brief: Slovak public procurement of banking and payments services is anchored on one statutory spine: ÚVO's Vestník verejného obstarávania (mandatory under zák. 343/2015 Z.z.), whose notices are published daily as open XML datasets on data.slovensko.sk and mirrored above-threshold to TED — together these three give near-complete, machine-readable coverage of contract and award notices with CPV 66xxx, 30144000/30233300 and 72xxx. The procedure layer sits in IS EVO / Elektronická platforma (evo.isepvo.sk), which carries the súťažné podklady where POS terminal, ATM and card-processing specifications actually live, while below-threshold and low-value purchases run through EKS/elektronické trhovisko and the resulting signed contracts surface in the Centrálny register zmlúv. A useful secondary tier of aggregators — UVOstat, Slovensko.Digital's APIs, OpenTender/OCDS and commercial monitors such as verejnesutaze.sk — makes historical and cross-country analysis far cheaper, but every figure should be re-verified against the ÚVO primary notice. The main practical constraint found is discovery, not access: individual notices are effectively invisible to web search, so collection must be built on the portals' own CPV search, the Vestník XML feed and the TED API.
